groups.problem: `<%- end if %>` in best.html.erb produces a Ruby syntax error when the template is compiled.
groups.rationale: Both point to line 6 and report the same stray `end if` syntax error, with the same fix.

groups.problem: PollFeed calls i.content.scrub without checking for entries that lack content, which crashes the whole poll run.
groups.rationale: Same line, same missing fallback to description/content:encoded, same effect of aborting the poll.

groups.problem: Imported feed HTML is stored with the raw_html cook method and never sanitized, which allows XSS.
groups.rationale: Both report that unsanitized external HTML skips the sanitization step through the raw_html cooking path.

groups.problem: The controller spec expects TopicRetriever to be built and run synchronously, but the controller only enqueues :retrieve_topic.
groups.rationale: Both point to the same test's mock expectations and propose asserting Jobs.enqueue instead.

groups.problem: absolutize_urls handles only leading-slash paths, so protocol-relative URLs (and other relative URLs) resolve to the wrong place; resolving them against the article URL fixes it.
groups.rationale: Both point to the same href/src rewriting code, report the protocol-relative URL being mangled, and propose resolving URLs against the article URL.
